progressSummary: Audited V3-03 requires repair; WIP baseline preserved when a safe delta existed.

openFindings.problem: Unified history pagination is incorrect. loadHistory fetches contributions and expenses with the same cursor then advances the cursor to the NEWER of the two repo cursors; the stream with the older cursor re-fetches entries already shown on the previous page, producing duplicate rows in the merged history whenever both ledgers are active and both have more than PAGE_SIZE entries. Additionally, the merged view is hard-capped at PAGE_SIZE*10=150 entries (paginateActivityLog limit), so after loading more pages the view still shows only the 150 newest entries: older loaded history is unreachable while 'Charger plus' keeps appearing. This breaks the acceptance criteria 'historique compact mixte et filtrable' and 'historique ancien paginé/cursor-based sans full download'.
openFindings.evidence: Simulation of the exact loadHistory logic with 20 interleaved contributions + 20 expenses (PAGE_SIZE=15): page 2 re-fetches c5 already shown in page 1 (merged count 41, unique 40, duplicate c5). Simulation of the merge cap: 600 loaded entries -> view shows 150, oldest visible c225, hasMore still true. The pagination tests only cover single-repo pagination and the pure paginateActivityLog function; the two-repo merged cursor path used by the screen is untested.
openFindings.requiredFix: Implement a single merged cursor-based pagination across the unified stream (e.g., page by occurredAt over both repos with one cursor and dedupe/merge deterministically, or fetch per-type pages keyed to the merged cursor), remove the hard 150-entry cap so every loaded page is visible, and add tests covering the two-repo merged pagination path (no duplicates, no skipped entries, older pages reachable).
openFindings.verification: Add a test that seeds >PAGE_SIZE interleaved contributions and expenses, loads 3+ pages through the screen's loadHistory logic, and asserts the merged list has no duplicate ids, no gaps, and that the oldest loaded entry is visible; re-run npm run check.

openFindings.problem: The contribution form does not conserve PersistentTask shortcuts, date/heure selection or the share action required by constitution §5A ('Conserver: libellé libre; PersistentTask / raccourcis de tâches; Fait par; Fait pour; date/heure; modification; suppression; partage') and by the V3-03 outcome ('Contribution conserve saisie libre, PersistentTask, Fait par/Fait pour, date, édition/suppression/partage sans chrono'). persistentTaskId is always null (no PersistentTask UI, even though the demo fixture seeds a 'Vaisselle' PersistentTask), occurredAt is always todayLocal() (no date picker), and history actions expose only Edit/Suppr (no share).
openFindings.evidence: add.tsx: cForm.persistentTaskId initialized null and never set by any UI control; occurredAt initialized todayLocal() and never changed by any control; historyActions renders only 'Edit' and 'Suppr' TouchableOpacity. demoFixture.ts seeds a PersistentTask 'Vaisselle' (line 80-90) that the Add screen never surfaces. NEXT_CYCLE.md objective 1 lists 'free label + PersistentTask + Fait par / Fait pour + date + edit/delete/share'.
openFindings.requiredFix: Add PersistentTask shortcuts to the contribution form (prefill label/value/beneficiaries from the selected PersistentTask), a date/heure selector for occurredAt, and a share action for entries (via the existing share port, honest adapter), keeping the form compact and chrono-free.
openFindings.verification: Manual/reference-scenario check that a PersistentTask can be selected and prefills the form, that occurredAt can be changed and is persisted, and that a share action is present and wired to the share port; keep npm run check green.
